description: List sender-sealed messages (app.aozora.convo.sendSealed). Selectors (either or both; results are the union; neither returns an empty list): toDid (+ optional convoId) lists intro-route records addressed to that DID; mailboxIds lists mailbox-route records (ADR-2610081200 R1) by their opaque session mailbox ids. The caller must decrypt each ciphertext (yoro-ui.interop.signal) to learn the sender, convo and content; nothing here reveals them server-side for mailbox-route records. Nothing about which caller asked for which mailbox id is persisted in any record, but the AppView necessarily learns that association at request time (same scope as Sealed Sender's server-side knowledge of the sender), plus whatever the transport reveals. Note: this is a public AppView read — a session token is attached when present but not required — so a toDid listing is readable by anyone who knows the DID, while a mailbox listing needs the id, which only the two session parties can derive.

mailboxIds.description: Opaque session mailbox ids (mailbox route). Over HTTP GET send them comma-joined in ONE mailboxIds parameter: the AppView router keeps only the last value of a repeated query key.

convoId.description: Filters intro-route records only; mailbox-route records carry no convoId in the clear.

mailboxId.description: Mailbox-route records only (returned instead of toDid).
